name: garbage_collection
label: Garbage collection — daily operations
description: Daily operational KPIs for a kerbside waste-collection service: tonnage, routes, fleet incidents, recycling performance, and the monthly compliance checkpoint.
notes: Cadences are mixed on purpose: most values are daily so operators can spot incidents quickly, while compliance/inspection live on a monthly bucket. Conditional fields (missed-route reason, breakdown description, failed-inspection notes) are gated by VisibleIf so the form only asks for them when they're relevant.

values.name: tonnes_collected
values.label: Tonnes collected
values.description: Total weight of waste collected today, measured at the gate before sorting.
values.warning: if(tonnes_collected > 200, 'Daily tonnage is unusually high (' + tonnes_collected + ' t). Please double-check.', null)

values.name: routes_completed
values.label: Routes completed
values.description: Number of scheduled collection routes that were fully serviced.

values.name: routes_missed
values.label: Routes missed
values.description: Scheduled routes that were not serviced today.
values.warning: if(routes_missed > 3, 'More than 3 routes missed today — operations team will want a follow-up.', null)

values.name: routes_missed_reason
values.label: Reason for missed routes
values.description: Free-text explanation. Only required when at least one route was missed today.

values.name: vehicle_breakdowns
values.label: Vehicle breakdowns
values.description: Number of collection vehicles that broke down during today's shift.
values.warning: if(vehicle_breakdowns >= 2, 'Two or more breakdowns in one day — consider opening a fleet-maintenance ticket.', null)

values.name: breakdown_description
values.label: Breakdown description
values.description: What happened, and where. Only shown when at least one breakdown was reported.

values.name: recycling_tonnes_collected
values.label: Recycling collected
values.description: Weight of material destined for recycling streams.
values.valueValidation: if(recycling_tonnes_collected < 0, 'Recycling tonnes cannot be negative.', null)

values.name: contamination_pct
values.label: Recycling contamination
values.description: Percentage of the recycling load that was contaminated (non-recyclable items in the recycling stream).
values.valueValidation: if(contamination_pct < 0 or contamination_pct > 100, 'Contamination must be a percentage between 0 and 100.', null)

values.name: customer_complaints
values.label: Customer complaints
values.description: Number of complaints logged with customer service for collections in this period.
values.warning: if(customer_complaints > 20, 'Complaint count is high (' + customer_complaints + ') — flag for the monthly ops review.', null)

values.name: monthly_inspection_passed
values.label: Monthly inspection passed
values.description: Result of the monthly council compliance inspection. Leave empty if not yet scheduled.

values.name: inspection_remediation_notes
values.label: Remediation notes
values.description: What's being done to address the failed inspection. Shown only when a failed inspection has been recorded.

layout.caption: Daily collection
layout.description: Headline operational metrics — completed by the depot supervisor at the end of every shift.

items.caption: Missed-route follow-up
items.description: Only appears when at least one route was missed today.

layout.caption: Fleet
layout.description: Track breakdowns separately from missed routes — a breakdown often causes a miss but not always.

items.caption: Breakdown details
items.description: Shown only when at least one vehicle broke down.

layout.caption: Recycling
layout.description: Performance of the recycling stream. Contamination rate is the lead indicator we share with the council.

layout.caption: Customer service & compliance
layout.description: Monthly metrics — leave blank on days that don't end a reporting month.

items.caption: Failed-inspection follow-up
items.description: Hidden unless the monthly inspection has been recorded as failed.
